issues.summary: Some lower-priority lessons were not written out; the detailed trees are narrower than the authoritative subject matrix.
The source provides no official root/version name, academic year, ministry edition, publication date, edition number, or effective date.
The three Biology chapter sequences have no explicit زیست‌شناسی ۱، زیست‌شناسی ۲، or زیست‌شناسی ۳ headings.
Some branches omit intermediate levels or mix فصل، بخش، درس، گفتار، موضوع, and unlabeled branches.
Cross-grade thematic Arabic, Persian, English, experimental Mathematics, and Literary Sciences trees lack an approved ownership/type classification.
مهارت‌ها و مباحث پیوندی ⭐ has no explicit owning parent.
The shared-Chemistry prose statement lacks an approved ownership or applicability interpretation.
The standalone رشته ریاضی فیزیک and انسانی headings need confirmed scope mappings.
One Arabic paragraph contains two intended-looking entries and must remain joined until an authorized decision.
The meaning of ⭐ is undefined; the marker must remain part of exact source text.
The source does not define prerequisites, objectives, hours, difficulty, assessment weights, aliases, equivalence mappings, or stable identifiers.
